description: This file is a Java source file defining the MetadataParser class, which is responsible for parsing headers and footers of bugreport files, extracting metadata such as start times, build identifiers, and report durations.

classes.name: MetadataParser
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to parse bugreport headers and footers to extract metadata such as timestamps and build identifiers.

methods.name: setBugreport
methods.description: Associates a Bugreport object with the parser for metadata extraction.

methods.name: parseHeader
methods.description: Parses lines from the bugreport to extract header metadata such as start time and build ID.

methods.name: parseFooter
methods.description: Parses footer information from the lines, computing end time based on duration.
